method: seeded stochastic local search from the prior 30-line V2 portfolio; one- and two-position line mutations; reject any mutation causing pairwise line intersection above two; score exact union of all 5-number draws with at least three hits; exhaustive final enumeration

historical_check_12396.note: post-hoc observation only; not a prospective test and not evidence of predictive edge

limitations: The search is heuristic; no global optimality claim is made.
The 4+ count is preserved by the pairwise-intersection-at-most-two constraint.
Coverage rates are fractions of the finite combination universe, not probabilities of predicting a fair future draw beyond the exact portfolio coverage.
No prospective performance or predictive edge is established.
